items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: With Artie. ... Georgie Auld. Les Robinson. Fine lead player.

ctx.x: : But you did some things that Lips Page sang on, with Artie.

With Artie. "Blues in the Night," Take Your Shoes Off, Baby. Several other things. Johnny Guarnieri was in the band then. Georgie Auld. Les Robinson. Fine lead player. Jack Jenney, and his wife sang. She sang This Time The Dream's On Me-" That was recorded.
: I don't know her. If you say the name, I'd probably know it. Who was he married to then?
